name: Client Call
description: What the client asked for, what was promised, and what is outstanding.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.instruction: What this call was about and where it left things, in three to five sentences.

sections.heading: Client Needs
sections.instruction: What the client asked for or described as a problem. Use their framing, not a reinterpretation of it.

sections.heading: Commitments Made
sections.instruction: Anything promised to the client, with dates where dates were given. Be exact: a commitment recorded more strongly than it was made is worse than one recorded weakly.

sections.heading: Objections and Risks
sections.instruction: Concerns the client raised and anything that could derail the work. Omit if none.

sections.heading: Next Steps
sections.instruction: What happens next, who owns it, and by when.
